4 اباخ He extinguished, or quenched, fire. (A, K.) And He (God) abated, or allayed, the heat. (A.) ―
-b2- [Hence,] اباخ النّائِرَةَ بَيْنَهُمْ (tropical:) [He extinguished, or assuaged, the discord, or rancour, or enmity, that was between them]. (A, TA.) ―
-b3- And أَبِخْ عَنْكَ مِنَ الظَّهِيرِةَ (assumed tropical:) Stay thou until the midday-heat shall have become allayed, and the air be cool. (IAar, TA in art. فيح and in the present art.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
